summary.plain: A custom set-up in Hall C: a long liquid-hydrogen target, a toroidal magnet and quartz detectors that counted the electrons scattered from protons for each beam-spin direction.
summary.technical: Custom Qweak apparatus in Hall C: 34.4 cm liquid-hydrogen target, collimators and a toroidal spectrometer focusing elastically scattered electrons onto fused-silica Cherenkov detectors with integrating readout (the apparatus is described in the Nature paper methods).

technology.quote: The Qweak experiment was performed with a custom apparatus installed in Hall C at the Thomas Jefferson National Accelerator Facility.
technology.value: Custom apparatus installed in Hall C: liquid-hydrogen target and spectrometer measuring the parity-violating asymmetry in elastic electron-proton scattering
